'''Major Damarus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], he allied with [[Kabbura]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in order to maintain the integrity of the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] in the [[Network Access]] sector.
